title: Translation And Letters Re Communists

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 532.
Date 28. 9. 29.
September 28, 29.

CHIN

Sir,

I have to acknowledge, with many thanks,
receipt of your communication dated September 26,
forwarding a list of alleged communists who are
wanted on a charge of plotting against the National
Government, and to inform you that enquiries are
now being made into the matter, and that the result
of these investigations will be communicated to you
in due course.

Yours faithfully,

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

President,
Provisional Court.

AC hol
28/9.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号：I. O. D. 532。
日期：29年9月28日。
1929年9月28日。

金先生台鉴：

谨此致谢，确认收到阁下于9月26日来函，随函附有一份涉嫌策划反对国民政府之共产党嫌疑人名单。现告知阁下，我方正在就此事项展开调查，调查结果将适时通报阁下。

此致
敬礼

代理刑事侦缉处处长

上海临时法院院长

AC hol
29/9/28

28. 9. 29.
Shanghai Provisional Court
Shanghai, Sept. 26, 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
I have received Secret Instruction No. 5051 from the
Kiangsu Provincial Government quoting Secret Instruction
received from the National Government quoting petition
submitted by Yang I-Hyoen, Chairman of the Chahar Provin-
cial Government, stating as follows:-

been allured by Soviet Russia with
riches and has already been trans-
formed by them. For years efforts
have been made in carrying on the
propaganda work and lately they have
again been engaged in attempting to
stage secret revolt. In view of my
province joining Outer Mongolia,
trouble will be immediately broken
out if there is any slight negligence
in the precautionary measures taken.
General Orders have been issued by my
Government for adopting extra strict
precautions and further capable Officers
have been secretly despatched to diff-
erent places to effect their captures but
fortunately nothing untoward happened.

29年9月28日。

上海临时法院
上海，1929年9月26日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长。

先生台鉴：

本人已收到江苏省政府第5051号密令，该密令援引自国民政府所收之密令，而国民政府之密令则引述了察哈尔省政府主席杨爱源（Yang I-Hyoen）（音译）呈递之请愿书，内容如下：

“经查，外蒙古已被苏俄以财富利诱，并已由其改造。多年来，对方一直从事宣传工作，近期又再次企图策划秘密叛乱。鉴于本省与外蒙古接壤，若在防范措施上稍有疏忽，祸乱必将立即爆发。本省政府已颁布通令，采取格外严密之防范措施，并秘密派遣干练警官前往各地实施抓捕，幸未发生任何意外事件。经与安全局协同行动，已逮捕……”

page_data.en:
2.
Communists named Yang Oong Dau, Yang Voong
Leu, Yang Teoong Nyi, Wong Kyeu Dzu, and
Wong Kwong Zung who had already been handed
over to the High Court of Justice to be
strictly dealt with in accordance with law.
Now the secret Detectives have discovered
that in the districts there and in various
other places, the Communists are secretly
becoming active. The names of their respon-
sible persons have been reported to my Govern-
ment."
"Apart from having strict orders issued
for diligent investigations to be made, effect-
ing their arrests for trial and punishment,
and submitting report thereon at all times, I
beg to submit you herewith report of inves-
tigations made regarding the movements of the
Communists who are utilizing every opportunity
at this juncture when the relations between
China and Soviet Russia are broken off and
further I beg to request that separate orders
be issued for their secret apprehensions so
as to do away with its troublesome origins
and be able to check their violent movements."
"Apart from having Secret Instructions
issued to the various Military and Political
Organs for their strict apprehensions for
trial and punishment, a list of the names is
forwarded herewith and you are hereby inst-
ructed to effect strict apprehensions for trial
and punishment."

“除已下达严厉命令，要求勤勉调查、实施逮捕以便审判和惩处，并随时提交相关报告外，谨此呈上关于共产党人活动情况的调查报告。这些共产党人正利用中俄关系破裂之际的各种机会。此外，恳请另行发布命令，对其实施秘密逮捕，以消除祸根，并遏制其暴力行动。”
“除已向各军事和政治机关发出秘密指令，要求严格实施逮捕以便审判和惩处外，现随函附上名单一份，兹指令你们严格执行逮捕，以便审判和惩处。”
